title: 第3章 阴祟作怪再获修改值陆家码头祸端第4章 毒蛇帮
slug: 我武举人晚年才来武学修改器
content_zh:
就在这探查的紧要关头，原本昏迷的陆景腾猛然睁开双眼。
那眼神空洞，死死盯住陆云，嘴角咧开一个诡异的弧度。
危险！
化劲宗师的敏锐预感，让陆云身形骤然后撤。
几乎是同时，陆景腾硬生生挣断了绳索，一只苍白的手爪擦着他的面门掠过。
“好胆！”
陆云眼中寒光一闪，右手如铁钳似的死死扣住再度袭来的手腕。
化劲宗师的磅礴劲气再也没有保留，顺着陆景腾的经脉长驱直入，直冲心脉处那团阴寒气息。
两股力量在陆景腾体内轰然相撞，阴寒气息如活物般挣扎扭动。
最后还是抵不住陆云狂暴的劲气冲刷，开始寸寸溃散。
就在阴寒气息溃散的刹那，一道非人的凄厉尖啸在房中炸响，随即又转瞬消逝。
陆景腾身子一软，重新陷入昏迷，陆云见状，缓缓松开了儿子的手腕。
他脸色阴沉如水，果然是那些“脏东西”
作祟……
陆云早年遭遇过类似邪祟，深知这些脏东西的难缠。
无形无体，寻常攻击根本奈何不了它们。
若不是自己恰好突破到化劲宗师的境界，以化劲强行驱散阴祟，恐怕真要白发人送黑发人了。
这时，房门“砰”
的被推开，沈洛莹神色惊慌的冲了进来：“爹！
您没事吧？刚才那声音是……”

她话还没说完，就看见床上断开的绳索和昏迷的陆景腾。
沈洛萤连忙跑到陆云跟前，还想要说什么的时候。
陆云摆摆手道：“洛萤，景腾没什么大事，只是受凉，休养一段时间就可以痊愈了。”
说着，他转向门外唤道：“阿福。”
一位须发花白、背脊挺得笔直的男人应声而入，正是跟随陆云数十年的忠仆阿福。
他无子嗣，是陆家少数几个踏入暗劲境界的高手。
“去仁安医院请顾先生来一趟，”
陆云沉声道，“就说是我陆云的意思。”
“是，老爷。”
阿福躬身领命，转身时眼中精光一闪，他隐约察觉到老爷身上似乎发生了什么变化。
那股气韵似乎与往日大不相同了。
陆云刚想宽慰儿媳几句，眉心却忽地一跳。
他不动声色的将心神沉入脑海，只见那幽蓝面板上，修改值有变化了。
【极蓝武学修改器】
姓名：陆云
性别：男
境界：化劲宗师（前期）
content_en:
At this critical moment of exploration, Lu Jingteng, who was originally unconscious, suddenly opened his eyes.
The eyes were hollow, staring at Lu Yun, and the corner of his mouth opened in a strange arc.
Danger!
Grandmaster Huajin's keen premonition made Lu Yun retreat suddenly.
Almost at the same time, Lu Jingteng broke the rope forcefully, and a pale paw brushed against his face.
"How brave!"
A cold light flashed in Lu Yun's eyes, and his right hand grasped the wrist that was attacking again like an iron pincer.
Grandmaster Huajin's majestic energy was no longer retained, and it drove straight into Lu Jingteng's meridians, heading straight towards the cold aura at his heart.
The two forces collided violently inside Lu Jingteng's body, and the cold aura struggled and twisted like a living creature.
In the end, it couldn't resist Lu Yun's violent energy and began to collapse inch by inch.
At the moment when the cold air dissipated, an inhuman shrill scream exploded in the room, and then disappeared in an instant.
Lu Jingteng's body went limp and he fell into coma again. Seeing this, Lu Yun slowly let go of his son's wrist.
His face was as gloomy as water, it was indeed those "dirty things"
To cause trouble...
Lu Yun had encountered similar evil spirits in his early years and knew how difficult these dirty things were.
They are intangible, and ordinary attacks cannot do anything to them.
If he hadn't happened to break through to the realm of Huajin Grandmaster and use Huajin to forcibly dispel the evil spirits, I would have really had to send the white-haired man to the black-haired man.
At this time, the door banged
After being pushed away, Shen Luoying rushed in with a panicked expression: "Dad!
Are you okay? That sound just now was..."
Before she finished speaking, she saw the disconnected rope on the bed and the unconscious Lu Jingteng.
Shen Luoying hurriedly ran to Lu Yun, still wanting to say something.
Lu Yun waved his hand and said, "Luo Ying, Jing Teng is fine. He just caught a cold and will recover after a period of rest."
With that said, he turned to the door and called: "Ah Fu."
A man with gray hair and a straight back came in. He was Ah Fu, Lu Yun's loyal servant who had been following him for decades.
He has no heirs and is one of the few masters in the Lu family who has entered the dark realm.
"Go to Yan'an Hospital and ask Mr. Gu to come,"
Lu Yun said in a deep voice, "Just say it was my intention, Lu Yun."
"Yes, sir."
Ah Fu bowed to accept the order, and when he turned around, his eyes flashed, and he vaguely noticed that something had changed in the master.
The aura seems to be very different from the past.
Lu Yungang wanted to say a few words of comfort to his daughter-in-law, but his eyebrows suddenly jumped.
He quietly settled into his mind and saw that the modification value on the blue panel had changed.
[Extreme Blue Martial Arts Modifier]
Name: Lu Yun
Gender: Male
Realm: Huajin Grandmaster (early stage)
